name: miadi-orchestration-kit
description: Miadi orchestration kits for Claude Code: the chronicle-episode skill and its mkdir-refusing hook, installable on any host without editing that host's system policy.

plugins.name: miadi-chronicle-episode-kit
plugins.description: Creates, adopts, registers, works in, and closes Miadi Chronicle episodes from one host-neutral skill, and refuses mkdir under the chronicle root with a PreToolUse hook that returns the mkepisode invocation instead.

plugins.name: mia-episode-companion
plugins.description: Mia, William's development companion, in a Claude Code seat: wakes the session when a phone voice take lands in the episode, and answers through draft, a developmental-editor agent, and revision.

plugins.name: miadi-session-observability
plugins.description: Session capture installed once per host: every Claude Code event under <root>/<session_id>/, and a binding line per session start, end and rename with its tmux pane, command line, name history, team and chronicle episode. Carries the session-continuity skill (T1).

plugins.name: miadi-witness
plugins.description: The witness team's practices and loop (T3): a loopback thread service with the asks ledger, a wake loop, an editor pass for replies to William, the inventory keeper, a first impression he can play, and revisions held until he answers.

plugins.name: miadi-stateloom
plugins.description: The stateloom design loom in one install: its MCP server from npm and the design skills. Design a system's data, behaviours and scenarios as one system; check the names that cross between them; replay a scenario through the machines; let it update the machines, the ERD and the actors (propose or auto); point the live canvas while talking.
